verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes its own API reference: a generated endpoint and schema reference (/llms-api.txt), a canonical OpenAPI schema, and a Developer MCP that gives AI assistants live access to the API reference. Its guides include worked requests (a first Transactions API call, a working POST /bills example) that can be run against the documented sandbox API base. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-browser interactive explorer or try-it console; the rendered docs pages are described only as JavaScript shells. missing for 10: an interactive try-it/explorer UI in the API reference, runnable examples embedded directly in the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
